correctness.rationale: The proof is universal and complete: row-rank lifting via invertible square roots, independent bottom-row strata (rank zero, one, two), exact parabolic-conjugation normal forms for rank one, nonvanishing leading minors, and explicit nilpotent three-chain squaring. All quantifiers n>=7 and all nullity-two B are justified. Exact rational examples across five cases at n=7,8,9,12 reproduce the key construction without substituting for proof.
